description: Internal links to add, crawled from this machine. Send site to audit a whole site, or url to find links to one page. Each link names a real sentence on the source and a real phrase from it as anchor text. With a TypeSafe key (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or the seoskill.dev account), Jev classifies pages and judges each link; without one the result says Jev was not used. Search Console query overlap is added when this login has the property.

detail.description: summary first. rows: the next page of links. full: every field as JSON.

max_pages.description: site only: pages to crawl, 500 by default, up to 5,000.

offset.description: rows only: the first link to return.

site.description: Site to audit: a domain, URL or Search Console property.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for Search Console. Optional; send with end_date.

url.description: One page to find links to.

name: seo_internal_links
title: Internal links
